review.notes: The folder's change is a ten-line Suggested.lean patch: HasHamiltonianField replaced by TauCeti.SmoothTwoForm.IsHamiltonianVectorField, whose body is the same (checked at the pin), plus new import lines. It elaborates with only five sorry warnings; #check @ was run on all 13 declarations; one-tactic probes found one padding statement (C01). The README is main's text, which the open revision #2690 (ordered first, conflicting) replaces, so its defects were not restated. Earlier review: R02 repaired by the suppliers' former-numbering paragraphs; R01 and C03 belong to the revision. Adversarial pass: 23 README statements sampled across R1-R5 with computed values, all hold. Sources: Cannas da Silva Def 22.1, Thm 23.1, 24.4, 25.3-25.4 and Huebschmann 2.18-2.32 read; Atiyah-Bott, Sjamaar-Lerman and Marsden-Ratiu not read. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks rerun: README hits are in main's text; the outside-folder hit (the family index) was set aside.
